margin-collapsing.title: Margin Collapsing Concept
margin-collapsing.history: Margin collapsing happens when vertical margins of adjacent block elements combine into a single margin instead of adding up.
margin-collapsing.tip: Vertical margins of adjacent block elements naturally merge into one single space; resolve this by adding padding, borders, or changing display modes.

margin-collapsing.quiz: What happens when vertical margins of two block elements meet?

inline-vs-block.title: Inline vs Block Elements
inline-vs-block.history: Inline elements flow within text and do not start on a new line, while block elements start on a new line and take full width.
inline-vs-block.tip: Block elements start on a fresh line and span 100% width; inline elements wrap content naturally and strictly ignore vertical margin adjustments.

line-box-formation.title: Line Box Formation
line-box-formation.history: Line boxes are created around inline elements inside a block container. They determine how inline content is aligned vertically.
line-box-formation.tip: Browser stacks sequential inline content inside invisible line boxes; vertical padding on inline elements extends backgrounds but never affects line-box layout calculations.

flex-grid-box-model.title: Flexbox/Grid Integration with Box Model
flex-grid-box-model.history: Flexbox and Grid layouts respect the box model, including margin, border, padding, and content, while providing advanced alignment and distribution.
flex-grid-box-model.tip: Advanced layout engines; flex handles structural rows or columns dynamically, while grid offers rigid multi-dimensional layouts for full canvas control.

stacking-context.title: Stacking Context
stacking-context.history: A stacking context is formed when elements have certain properties (like position, opacity, or z-index). It determines how elements are layered on top of each other.
stacking-context.tip: A localized 3D layering group created by specific properties (opacity < 1, transforms, high z-index); children cannot breakthrough parent context limits.
